mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_id, o.departure, o.destination, o.departure_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.number_of_people, o.joined_number, o.remark, o.status, o.stuNumber, o.username, o.phone from chat_app.carpool_join j inner join chat_app.order_carpool o on j.order_id = o.order_id where j.stu_number = #{stuNumber} and o.status = 1 order by j.create_time desc
